subject: Request: Split invoice cycle + extended payment window for Orion Labs
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@orionlabs.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@orionlabs.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOW & PO submitted — request for split invoice cycle + extended term

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get started. We've uploaded a signed SOW (attached) and a PO from procurement referencing Redwood's enterprise terms. Our finance team has a hard constraint: they require either Net-90 or quarterly invoices aligned with our internal budgeting windows.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood accept a split-invoice approach (50% upfront on kickoff, remaining invoiced quarterly over the first year)?
- If not, can you approve Net-90 for the first 12 months while we finalize our internal renewal approvals?

I've attached the PO and the exec-approved SOW for reference. We can be flexible on a small prepayment if that helps. Please let me know what information you need from our side (credit references, billing contact, etc.).

Best,
Olivia Chen
Head of Procurement, Orion Labs
(attachment: Orion_SOW_v3.pdf, Orion_PO_20260720.pdf)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOW & PO submitted — request for split invoice cycle + extended term

Team — forwarding Orion's ask. Key points: they want either Net-90 or a split/quarterly invoice schedule. Deal size is $480k ARR first year, onboarding starting Aug 1. Ben is the AE on record.

My read: Orion is strategic (edge-device fleet) and this could lead to a cross-sell opportunity in Q1. I can accept a milestone-based split (kickoff 30%, then quarterly) if Finance signs off, otherwise consider Net-60 as a concession. Net-90 feels risky without credit / payment protection.

Can you review and advise:
- Marissa: finance impact / collection risk and any required guardrails?
- Rishi: deal desk recommendation and whether we can attach a rollout holdback or SLA credit to protect us.
- Ben: timeline sensitivities on sales motion.

Thanks — Priya

Priya —

Thanks for flagging. A few quick finance notes after reviewing the PO & SOW:
- If we do Net-90 we should require a one-time security deposit or a 20% prepayment to reduce exposure.
- Split/milestone invoicing is acceptable; recommended structure: 30% kickoff, then equal quarterly invoices for the remainder (30/23.33/23.33).
- Need customer legal to sign our standard paper on late fees and interest.
- Please obtain two credit references and confirm billing contact email for AP.

I've attached a quick spreadsheet with cashflow scenarios (proposed_payment_schedule.xlsx). If deal desk approves a term, we'll add it to the invoice template and set AR watch.

Subject: Re: Fwd: SOW & PO submitted — request for split invoice cycle + extended term

Quick deal-desk take:
- Approve milestone/split invoices as Marissa suggested. That keeps cashflow more predictable and limits exposure.
- If Orion insists on a pure Net-90, approve only as a one-time exception for Year 1 and only with BOTH: (a) 15% prepayment, and (b) an irrevocable bank guarantee or equivalent credit enhancement.
- Do NOT approve rolling Net-90 without stronger credit terms.

If team wants Net-90 for the pilot, I'll document the exception and route to Aditya for exec sign-off. Otherwise we can approve the 30% kickoff + quarterly invoices today and Ben can push for the milestone acceptance.

Rishi
Head of Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

Olivia — thanks for sending the PO. Quick note from the sales side:
- Orion's procurement is asking Net-90 due to fiscal calendar — if we can do the kickoff 30% + quarterly thereafter, that would unblock procurement immediately and keep your implementation on track for Aug.
- If Finance needs a prepayment, Orion can do 15% upfront; they asked if that would be sufficient.

Can you confirm that your AP contact can sign the modified payment schedule and share the preferred billing email so we can update the PO? Once you confirm, I'll coordinate the SOW countersign and initial invoice.

Cheers,

Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2026 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: SOW & PO submitted — request for split invoice cycle + extended term

Team — after weighing strategic value and risk, approved exception as follows:
- Approve the milestone/split schedule: 30% kickoff, then equal quarterly invoices for the remainder of Year 1.
- Accept a one-time Net-90 for Year 1 ONLY if Orion provides a 15% prepayment and a signed payment guarantee (bank or corporate guarantee) before the first invoice is issued.
- Finance to put an AR watch and hold renewal/discount approvals until invoices clear for 6 months.
- Legal to add a clause for late fee accrual and a 60-day grace escalation to collections.

Marissa/Rishi: please document the exception in FIN-1219, update the invoice templates, and notify Ben so he can close the loop with Orion. Ben: push the milestone schedule; if Orion accepts the guarantee + 15% prepayment, we can sign Net-90 for year one.

Aditya Rao
VP, Revenue & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
